title: I promoted an egg to king. The rest of the carton immediately wanted titles. 👑🥚
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
So now we have Royal Shells... its the classic chess with a very fragile royal family.

Everyone got a helmet, a little pedestal, and an unreasonable amount of confidence. The knight got several fittings because apparently putting a horse-shaped helmet on an egg is a whole separate thing.

You can play against the castle computer, challenge a friend online, or pass one device back and forth while pretending your last move was intentional.

It’s free in your browser:  
[Play Royal Shells](https://eggverse.co/games/royal-shells)

Protect your king. Try not to get scrambled 🫣
